name: Diagnostic_EQN-LIN_4
questiontext:
If \(y = {{CT:0}}x + {{CT:1}}\) then what is \(x\) equal to?

\(x =\) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Rearranging purely algebraic equations is no different to numerical questions:
 \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
 y &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:0}}x + {{CT:1}}, \qquad\mbox{first take {{CT:1}} from each side} \\
 y - {{CT:1}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:0}}x, \qquad\mbox{now divide through by {{CT:0}}} \\
 \frac{y - {{CT:1}}}{{CT:0}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  x, \qquad\mbox{i.e.} \\
 x &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:2}}.
  \end{array}\]
